result.planSummary: Aligned Story 2’s checkpoint path so artifact identity stays project-scoped while later revisions append new artifact versions with version-level process provenance, and updated the in-memory/read-model paths plus tests to derive current summaries from latest durable versions.

changedFiles.reason: Removed artifact-row process ownership from checkpoint persistence so revising a project artifact keeps the same artifact identity and only appends a new version row.
Aligned the in-memory platform store with Story 2 by deriving artifact summaries from latest version history and avoiding ownership-style rewrites during checkpoint persistence.
Preserved producing-process display provenance even when artifact review content loading falls back to an error state.
Added durable-state coverage for multi-process revisions keeping one artifact identity while recording separate version provenance.
Added server coverage proving project-shell artifact summaries resolve currentVersionLabel and updatedAt from the latest durable version.
Strengthened review API assertions so producing-process provenance remains visible in normal and degraded artifact review responses.

gatesRun.command: corepack pnpm exec vitest run convex/artifacts.test.ts tests/service/server/project-shell-bootstrap-api.test.ts tests/service/server/artifact-review-api.test.ts tests/integration/review-workspace.test.ts --environment node

findingsFixed: Removed the Convex artifact-row reassignment behavior that let later checkpoint revisions overwrite artifact ownership semantics.
Aligned in-memory shell/material artifact summaries with latest artifact version history so later revisions remain current even when producedAt ordering differs.
Preserved producing-process provenance labels in degraded artifact review responses instead of dropping them on content-fetch/render errors.

result.recommendedNextStep: Proceed to story verification against AC-2.1 through AC-2.3 using the green-verify/verify-all evidence and reviewer spot-checks on multi-process revision flows.
